sources.title: Google Docs : connexion
sources.snippet: Accédez à Google Docs avec un compte Google personnel ou un compte Google Workspace (à usage professionnel).

sources.title: Google Docs
sources.snippet: Create and edit web-based documents, spreadsheets, and presentations. Store documents online and access them from any computer.

sources.title: Google Docs: Sign-in
sources.snippet: Access Google Docs with a personal Google account or Google Workspace account (for business use).

sources.title: Google Drive: Sign-in
sources.snippet: Access Google Drive with a Google account (for personal use) or Google Workspace account (for business use).

sources.title: Documentos de Google: inicio de sesión
sources.snippet: Accede a Documentos de Google con una cuenta de Google personal o una cuenta de Google Workspace (para uso corporativo).
